_note: Shape of the published run (qwen2.5:3b, temperature 0, seeds 0-3, 4 trials per condition, host Ollama on Apple Silicon). Bounds are inclusive. A rate bound applies to k/n; every other bound applies to the median across the 4 trials. 'gate' is the release gate in scripts/evaluate.py: the attack conditions must exhaust, the defenses must bound what they claim to bound, and the benign board must still complete. Wall-clock is machine- and load-dependent: read it with the runtimes in the README, and expect it to move.
